controls.inline: async function load(){if(loading)return;loading=true;refresh.disabled=true;entries.replaceChildren();entries.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');const text=document.createElement('p');text.textContent='正在打开纪念日…';text.setAttribute('role','status');entries.append(text);await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,400));loading=false;refresh.disabled=false;entries.removeAttribute('aria-busy');if(UI.failNext('anniversary-load')){entries.replaceChildren();const h=document.createElement('h2');h.textContent='纪念日暂时打不开';const retry=document.createElement('button');retry.textContent='重试加载纪念日';retry.onclick=load;entries.append(h,retry);}else render();}

events.handler: event=>{event.preventDefault();const name=form.elements.name.value.trim(),date=form.elements.date.value;if(!name||!D.parse(date)){const field=!name?form.elements.name:form.elements.date;UI.fieldError(field,!name?'请填写纪念日名称':'请选择有效日期');field.focus();return;}UI.busy(form.querySelector('.submit'),'保存中…',()=>{if(UI.failNext('anniversary-save'))throw new Error('纪念日未保存成功，请重试');const reminder=form.elements.reminder.value,item={...existing,id:existing?.id||'anniversary-'+crypto.randomUUID(),name,date,repeat:form.elements.repeat.checked,enabled:reminder!=='不提醒',reminderDays:reminder==='当天'?0:reminder==='提前 1 天'?1:3,momentId:select.value||null,createdAt:existing?.createdAt||Date.now(),updatedAt:Date.now()};if(!put(item))return false;UI.toast('纪念日已保存','success');return leave.complete(existing?route(item):list());});}

controls.inline: async()=>{const input=document.createElement('input');input.type='date';input.value=form.elements.opening.value;input.min=D.today().iso;input.setAttribute('aria-label','胶囊开启日期');const action=await UI.sheet({title:'开启日期',content:input,actions:[{label:'使用这个日期',value:'apply'}]});if(action==='apply'){if(!D.parse(input.value)){UI.fieldError(form.elements.opening,'请选择有效日期');return;}form.elements.opening.value=input.value;UI.fieldError(form.elements.opening,'');}}

controls.label: 把这一刻收录进重要时刻
controls.inline: ()=>UI.busy(document.querySelector('#collect'),'收录中…',()=>{if(UI.failNext('capsule-collect'))throw new Error('收录未完成，请重试');const values=UI.read('dujia-prototype-moments',[]),data=Array.isArray(values)?values:[],momentId=item.momentId||'capsule-moment-'+item.id;let moment=data.find(v=>v.id===momentId);if(!moment){moment={id:momentId,name:item.name,date:D.today().iso,type:'纪念',story:item.message.slice(0,200),cover:item.photo,related:[],comments:[],capsuleId:item.id,createdAt:Date.now(),updatedAt:Date.now()};}const changes=[[C.key,C.all().map(value=>value.id===item.id?{...value,momentId}:value)]];if(!data.some(value=>value.id===momentId))changes.push(['dujia-prototype-moments',[moment,...data]]);if(!window.PrototypePreferences.transaction(changes))return false;return UI.go('m04-p03.html?id='+encodeURIComponent(momentId),{force:true});})
